mechanism.claim: When BTC's completed three-calendar-day and fourteen-calendar-day returns have the same sign at a low-turnover twice-weekly decision, short-horizon price discovery is aligned with the medium trend and should persist for the next three elapsed days.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed 3-day and 14-day log returns
mechanism.why_distinct: STCR is a fixed Monday/Thursday calendar relay with no rank, magnitude, volatility entry gate, fitted model, order flow, funding, OI, external market, Gross9 state, or prior candidate control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: the full-calendar policy is evaluated separately on the exact causal RV20 q90 stress slice and against an identical-clock persistent-long-vol comparator
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only two fixed UTC decision opportunities per week with three-day reservation

features.reference: BTCUSDT perpetual exact UTC calendar-day close from completed 5m bars
features.decision_time: 00:00 UTC after the prior UTC day is complete
features.eligible: both finite, nonzero, and identical strict sign

rv20_stress_slice.daily_return: log(C_d/C_{d-1}) assigned to UTC calendar day d
rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) over exact returns t-20 through t-1
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear 0.90 quantile over 756 available RV20 observations with decision timestamps strictly before t; current excluded
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: report-only until all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.entry: exact decision time + one completed 5m bar, at 00:05 UTC
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted candidate entry/exit clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.full_calendar_decomposition: candidate net return minus comparator net return
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition restricted by causal RV20 state at candidate decision

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT 1m through 2026-08-01; exact five-minute overlap parity required
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no schedule, horizon, agreement, side, hold, RV20, threshold, subset, comparator, or gate repair
